title: Research Snacks: compact reading journeys
status: Coordinator inspection first; not ready for an owner decision while height targets fail
purpose: Check a public claim quickly, compare its evidence and follow a number to its source.
user: Existing readers, sceptics, visual browsers and phone readers.

commitments.text: Keep the live cream publication and left sidebar at 950px.
Preserve every source table cell, link and original order.
Make comparison faster with compact reversible table views.
Do not increase page height: five desktop comparisons currently fail; owner review is held.

today.text: The live outline, facts, references, data, citation, RSS and Markdown work. Its home wastes vertical space and its general tables have no sort/filter/full-view tools. The first redesign was rejected for worsening navigation and density.
